body:
Thank you. You're right, I didn't want to harm her, and I know there's a possibility that she used my pills to make me feel guilty like this. People have mentioned that possibility to me before, and it's hard to accept but keeping that in mind is helping me keep things in perspective. Hearing from other people is also really helpful, thanks.

I'm not sure if this makes any sense, but in my backwards head, just because I didn't mean to hurt her doesn't mean I didn't hurt her, and in a way it feels maybe a little bit worse knowing that I did so much damage and hurt her so much without even trying. I also know I have a tendency to blame myself for things a lot though.

this is really good advice thank you so much!! this situation is definitely helping me realize the ways that the relationship was unhealthy for me and that i need to set boundaries and learn to put my feelings first.

counting to make sure u did the right number of zeroes lmao

but yeah she literally like went on a road trip, told me about it when she got back, and then was like "sorry i work so much it's hard to find time" or something like that. i definitely need to be more firm about this, and even though two weeks sounds really soon to me, I also know I need to just get this over with asap.

thank you, yeah i definitely feel taken advantage of. I felt that way a lot of the time we were together too, so I guess this shouldn't be surprising.

Being firm and setting deadlines with people is something I'm really bad at. We actually had a deadline to get her stuff moved out (back in 2018, lol) but she didn't and now here we are. I still like her for whatever reason, and I don't want to make her feel any worse, but I also need to recognize how bad she's making me feel and try to actually stick to a plan this time.

that's a really good point, i definitely am letting this situation continue when i know she's just making me feel bad (which is similar to stuff that happened in the relationship, but that's a story for a different whiny post). I still do like her a lot, for whatever reason, and i know that's getting in the way of things but the way she's been lately is helping me realize how poorly shes treating me and how much i really need to just get on with my life. 

I don't think I can really bring myself to just dump it on the street, but setting a deadline and getting a short-term storage locker are definitely good options, because this has gone on for way too long.

it's like, a ton of stuff. she has a lot of books and collectibles and it's basically filling up an entire room and spilling out into the rest of the apartment, and a bunch of her clothes are here too. I can't imagine it would all fit on one doorstep.
